Alternative: make the brute force dedupe leaf modes more aggressively — it already dedupes by (P,B). For a single-run leaf: mode 0 → P=ceil(48/64)=1, B=ceil(1/4)+dec[0]=1+dec0; mode 1 → P=ceil(40/64)=1, B=1+dec1; mode 2 → P=ceil(36/64)=1, B=1+dec2.
